svg.title: How DORADO_DEMUX CPUs and memory are decided
svg.desc: CPUs and memory are decided independently. First, a withName DORADO_DEMUX block in an extra -c config wins. Otherwise --dorado_cpus or --dorado_mem is used if set. Otherwise, inputs over 1 GB (--large_input_gb) get 4 CPUs and 15 GB, smaller inputs 2 CPUs and 7 GB.

g.text: "Input" = the file one Dorado task gets
A chunk when a single file is split (default), otherwise each input file
